edges.mechanism: reactor operation requires reliable fuel supply
edges.falsifier: reactor retirements, demand destruction or alternative fuel supply materially eliminate the projected primary-supply need

edges.mechanism: mine/mill construction can convert reserves into production
edges.falsifier: financing, cost, schedule, technical or operating-licence failure prevents economic production

edges.mechanism: higher capital needs raise financing burden and delay cash generation
edges.falsifier: secured funding plus on-budget milestones materially reduce the remaining capital gap
